title: RegisterPlugin
description: A custom login plugin suitable for servers
body:
✨ Features
🔐 Secure player registration
🔑 Login system
🛡️ BCrypt password encryption
💾 SQLite database support
🚀 Lightweight & optimized
📁 Easy configuration
👑 OP-only /resetregister command
🚫 Prevents movement before login
📜 Customizable messages
⚡ Fast startup and low memory usage
✅ Supports Paper 1.21 - 1.21.11




------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Command	Description
/register <password> <password>	Register a new account
/login <password>	Login to your account
/resetregister <player>	Reset a player's account (OP only)
